sanskrit_verse:
आगर्भसंभवाद् गच्छेत् पतितस् त्व् अन्यथा भवेत् ।
अनेन विधिना जातः क्षेत्रजो ’स्य भवेत् सुतः ॥ ६९ ॥
transliteration: āgarbhasaṃbhavād gacchet patitas tv anyathā bhavet | anena vidhinā jātaḥ kṣetrajo 'sya bhavet sutaḥ || 69 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: If conception occurs within lawful union, the child proceeds in purity; otherwise, the child descends into degradation. By this law, the son born of the field—kṣetraja—is declared.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from lawful generative union sanctioned by Dharma
Causation is determined by integrity of origin, not biological fact alone
Capacity-based responsibility extends to progenitors and societal guardians
Restoration logic demands alignment of lineage with cosmic order
Consciousness alignment requires purification of generative intent
executable_legal_axioms: ALL generative_agents MUST undergo consciousness_realignment BEFORE legal recognition
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters of inheritance, legitimacy, and parental rights, the Supreme Court shall recognize kṣetraja status based on dharmic sanction of the union, not biological parentage alone. The threshold of responsibility lies in the conscious intent and ritual alignment of the generative act.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causal purity determines outcome. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that degraded origin necessitates sequential restoration. Proportional responsibility rests with those who enabled or neglected dharmic alignment. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that misalignment is corrected through conscious realignment, not punitive exile.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Assign Consciousness Mentor to Kṣetraja Child
Restore Generative Sanctity Through Ritual Completion
Realign Parental Consciousness With Dharmic Union Protocols
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
